## Classic Chocolate Chip Cookies (with walnuts)

The standard recipe at its peak — crisp edge, chewy center.

**Ingredients**
- 2¼ cups all-purpose flour
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 1 tsp salt
- 1 cup unsalted butter, softened
- ¾ cup brown sugar
- ¾ cup granulated sugar
- 2 eggs
- 2 tsp vanilla
- 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
- 1 cup chopped walnuts

**Method**
Cream butter and sugars. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix in flour, baking soda, salt. Fold in chocolate chips and walnuts. Scoop onto parchment, bake at 375F for 9-11 minutes until edges are golden. Cool on the pan 5 minutes.
